glosses: land; region; territory (area associated with something)
ground (the surface of the Earth outside buildings)
land; property (partitioned and measurable area owned by someone)

examples.en: I want to sell my land.

examples.text: Ele é o dono desta terra.
examples.en: He is the owner of this land.
He owns a lot of land.

examples.text: Ele vai te fazer comer terra.
examples.en: He will make you eat dirt.
